reading.zh: 根层四个支柱：客户端 bili.client、共享契约 bili.contract、业务域（身份→内容→互动→交易→治理）、数据契约 bili.data 与基础设施 bili.infra。先冻结契约再并行业务域。
reading.en: Four pillars: clients, shared contracts, business domains (identity to content, interaction, commerce, governance), data and infrastructure. Freeze contracts before parallelizing domains.
